research_question: Does 2020-2026 evidence change the current ERAP1 axSpA decision, critical uncertainty or recommended experiment?

date_window.field: publication date; ambiguous dates require review

query_families.A: ERAP1 AND ("ankylosing spondylitis" OR "axial spondyloarthritis" OR axSpA OR "HLA-B27")
query_families.B: ERAP1 AND ("HLA-B27" OR immunopeptidome OR "peptide trimming" OR "antigen presentation" OR "free heavy chain" OR homodimer OR KIR3DL2 OR Th17)
query_families.C: ERAP1 AND (allotype OR haplotype OR polymorphism OR variant OR genotype) AND ("HLA-B27" OR "ankylosing spondylitis" OR "axial spondyloarthritis")
query_families.D: ERAP1 AND (inhibitor OR activator OR modulator OR "small molecule" OR compound OR pharmacology)
query_families.E: ERAP1 AND (binding OR binder OR "target engagement" OR occupancy OR "thermal shift" OR CETSA OR NanoBRET OR biophysical OR crystallography OR "cryo-EM")
query_families.F: ERAP1 AND ("structure activity relationship" OR SAR OR inhibitor OR "medicinal chemistry" OR compound OR "chemical series" OR scaffold)
query_families.G: ERAP1 AND (structure OR crystal OR crystallography OR conformational OR allosteric OR "binding site" OR pocket)
query_families.H: ERAP1 AND ("axial spondyloarthritis" OR "ankylosing spondylitis") AND (patient OR biomarker OR clinical OR trial OR treatment OR therapeutic)

source_adaptation: PubMed and Europe PMC: Boolean families with publication-date filter. Crossref: ERAP1 keyword discovery with publication-date filters and complete cursor pagination; Boolean equivalence not claimed. Other sources: target-specific queries retained in execution log.
inclusion_criteria: Primary human genetics, molecular/cellular, biochemical, structural, chemical or clinical ERAP1 evidence capable of affecting an AXIS layer
Transferable mechanistic or chemistry evidence from another disease may qualify, with explicit context boundary
Negative, null and contradictory results are equally eligible
Preprints separately labelled and pending review
exclusion_criteria: Incidental ERAP1 mention without relevant result
Review/commentary without new primary evidence (retain for discovery only)
Duplicate report or reanalysis not independent replication
Outside recent window (already-indexed and historical gaps retained separately)
Insufficient methodological information: defer rather than invent claims
deduplication_policy: Normalize DOI, then PMID/PMCID/trial ID; normalized title fallback. Preserve preprint-publication, correction-original and shared-study links; do not count them as independent replication.
screening_procedure: Stage 1 title/abstract with explicit state/reason for every record; stage 2 full text where required/accessible. Abstract-only claims must be explicitly scoped. Screening/extraction is AI-assisted single reviewer; independent review pending.

citation_expansion.seed_policy: Included high-materiality mechanism, engagement, chemistry and translational papers; record forward/backward discovery paths and unavailable endpoints

claim_extraction_rules: One source-supported proposition per claim, with locator, experimental context, entity links, direction, limitations and pending_review. Binding, enzyme activity, cellular engagement, phenotype and genetic dependency are distinct. Missing fields are not_reported/not_assessed; no efficacy inference from association.
decision_impact_rules: Use unchanged AXIS engine rules. Per-study impact is a separately labelled inference with affected layer/hypothesis/explanation/uncertainty/strategy/experiment, direction and written materiality rationale. Rebuild immutable state only after import; classify evidence versus rule/review changes separately. No manual downstream edits.
review_policy: All new AI-assisted claims pending_review; agent cannot accept its own interpretation.
clinical_negative_language: No relevant clinical evidence identified in successfully searched sources within this protocol; never claim no evidence exists.
amendment_policy: Hash protocol before searches. Subsequent amendments require new version, reason and date; retain previous protocol.
copyright_policy: Retain permitted metadata/identifiers and factual extraction; no copyrighted full-text PDFs redistributed. Full texts used for reading remain outside repository unless licensed for redistribution.
stop_rule: No updated commercial brief or completed-refresh claim until search, screening, curation, immutable decision replay and validation are complete. Report incompleteness explicitly. No Phase 3.10.
